name: Hangout House
creator: Munificent
description: Hangout House is an indoor social world created in mid-2018 by the user Munificent. It offers a cozy house-style layout with tabletop-style social games such as chess and four-in-a-row, plus a basement movie theater where visitors can queue up videos to watch together. It has remained a low-key, long-running spot for small-group hangouts rather than a large public party space.
